criteriaLedger.week: sales base is calendar major +1 (2026-08-31 => 36), then base+1/+2/+3; each exposes subweek 01/02 and a pasted in-range WW-S automatically becomes the exact selected year+week
criteriaLedger.manager: defaults to authenticated userName when that manager exists; selected display name is resolved to active UserInfo.UserID before OrderMaster write
criteriaLedger.customer: explicit selected CustKey is authoritative; pasted customer text cannot redirect the write
criteriaLedger.matching: reuse /api/orders/parse-paste and its persisted customer/product mappings; country+flower headers such as 콜 수국 are carried into matchName while display inputName stays 수국 화이트; unmatched or nonpositive rows block the whole write
criteriaLedger.currentOrder: exact OrderYear + OrderWeek + CustKey product quantities load before analysis and reload after verified commit
criteriaLedger.write: source=sales-paste uses my-customer optimistic-lock ADD policy and post-write ViewOrder verification
criteriaLedger.stock: ADD retains the existing FormOrderAdd-compatible stock calculation/warning path; it must not perform a direct manual stock adjustment
criteriaLedger.forbidden: never call shipment adjust/distribute APIs and never create or update ShipmentMaster, ShipmentDetail, ShipmentDate, ShipmentFarm, Estimate or profit ledgers
